explication: OpenClaw is a self-hosted AI assistant spanning a local Gateway, messaging channels, and native companion apps. The main workflow is a user message entering through a channel or Control UI, reaching the Gateway for session and tool coordination, then using a configurable agent/model harness to produce a reply. The graph also preserves documented extensions, device-node capabilities, and session, memory, and credential state. Several subsystem links are documented only at a high level; unsampled implementation relationships are omitted rather than inferred.
